fork_relationship.interpretation: The current branch preserves shared historical node UUIDs and content but re-stamps session identity/version. This is a reserialized history prefix and new branch, not a byte copy or truncation of the old JSONL.

event_semantics.assistant_thinking: Extended-thinking content block, possibly one fragment of a streamed assistant message.
event_semantics.assistant_text: User-visible content, not the full reasoning trace.
event_semantics.assistant_tool_use: Structured request for a tool action.
event_semantics.user_tool_result: Tool result transported with API user role; not human speech.
event_semantics.system_stop_hook_summary: Harness summary after Stop hooks; not model self-reflection.
event_semantics.attachment: Harness-injected context node such as task reminder or skill/agent listing.
event_semantics.last_prompt: Recovery snapshot containing recent human prompt text and the current transcript leaf at write time. leafUuid can point to assistant, user or attachment and the record may repeat during streaming or resume; it is not necessarily the prompt UUID.
event_semantics.custom_title: Display title injected or adopted by the Desktop/session layer.
event_semantics.ai_title: Semantic title generated by Claude Code; may coexist with custom_title.
event_semantics.mode_normal: Conversation mode metadata; distinct from permissionMode acceptEdits.

confirmed: Desktop keeps a stable local task identity and maps it to a current CLI session ID.
CLI-style JSONL files persist the message graph and control events.
Desktop can merge disk transcript state with pending streamed events.
not_strictly_proven: Which process wrote every individual JSONL line.
Whether all canonical transcript writes were performed by Desktop rather than the CLI worker.
